feeds.title: Midwest Garden Gal Blog
feeds.description: Spectacular Spaces Made Simple. I'm Lisa Hinzman Howard and I want you to know that gardening doesn't need to be scary, crazy time consuming or tons of hard work. I can help. Life is a grand experiment and gardening is the perfect outlet for our creative energies not to mention great for body and soul.

feeds.title: Ohio Tropics Houseplant
feeds.description: This blog focuses on adventures in growing orchids and other tropical houseplants, as well as outdoor gardening in the Midwest with a tropical flair.

feeds.title: Midwest Life and Style Blog » Home & Garden
feeds.description: Jen Svendsen started Midwest Life and Style with a dream of sharing her love of interior design and homemaking with others. Midwest Life and Style is filled with creativity including, made-from-scratch recipes, heartfelt, Midwestern hospitality, and inspiration for everyday living. From simple DIY projects to holiday celebrations and home styling tips, Jen proves that you don't need a big budget to create a beautiful and inviting home.

feeds.title: Midwest Cut Flowers Blog
feeds.description: Hey there, I am Rhonda. I am here to enrich your home with flowers, vintage decor and food. Sustainable growing, quality eco-conscious home decor and tried and true recipes are all found on the blog!

feeds.title: The Midwest Kitchen Blog » Gardening
feeds.description: Easy From Scratch Recipes Using Organic and All-Natural Ingredients. Hello, I'm Tonya and I run The Midwest Kitchen Blog LLC. I was born in the Midwest and raised in the South. My family is from the Midwest and the South, so my recipes are a mix of the two!

feeds.title: Barn Owl Garden Center
feeds.description: The Barn Owl Garden Center blog gives you easy-to-understand gardening resources, easy tools, and home care advice to make your home and garden project a breeze.
